exposure: Women with GDM treated with insulin (G1) and those treated with metformin (G2)
cohort: 399 women with GDM, with 135 requiring pharmacological treatment.
finding: Metformin provided similar maternal and fetal outcomes to insulin for GDM treatment, with comparable rates of complications and neonatal outcomes.
birth_weight: Newborns of mothers treated with metformin had a higher rate of birth weight <2500g.
